note.first: सहायक सरकारी वकील, मा. उच्च न्यायालय, खंडपीठ औरंगाबाद यांच्या पृ.1/प.वि. वरील दि. __.__.2026 रोजीच्या पत्रास अनुसरून सादर.
paras: उपरोक्त याचिकेच्या अनुषंगाने सदर प्रकरणाची पार्श्वभूमी थोडक्यात खालीलप्रमाणे आहे:-

विधीविषयक कामकाज चालविण्याचे नियम, 1984 (Rules for the Conduct of the Legal Affairs of Government, 1984) मधील नियम 58(3) मध्ये “shall prepare or obtain parawise report on all the points raised in the Writ Petition and affidavit.” अशी तरतूद आहे. नियम 58(4) मध्ये प्रकरणाची कागदपत्रे “within two weeks from the date of receipt by it” सरकारी वकील यांना पाठविण्याची तरतूद आहे.
याचिकेतील प्रत्येक परिच्छेदावरील या विभागाचे अभिप्राय या विभागाच्या अभिलेखाच्या आधारे इंग्रजीमध्ये तयार करण्यात आले आहेत. सदर अभिप्रायांसोबत संबंधित शासन निर्णयांच्या प्रती जोडण्यात आल्या आहेत.

0: (1) सदर पत्रान्वये रिट याचिका क्र. ____/2026 (श्री. अ. ब. चाचणी विरुद्ध महाराष्ट्र शासन व इतर) मध्ये प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 (विधि व न्याय विभाग) यांचे परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय पाठविण्याबाबत कळविण्यात आले आहे. सदर याचिका दि. __.__.2026 रोजी सुनावणीसाठी आहे (पृ.1/प.वि.).
(3) सदर निवेदन मा. उच्च न्यायालयाच्या दि. __.__.2025 रोजीच्या पत्रासोबत शासनास प्राप्त झाले होते (पृ.3/प.वि.).
(4) या विभागाने क्र. संकिर्ण-2025/____/प्र.क्र.____/का.6, दि. __.__.2025 च्या पत्रान्वये सदर निवेदनाबाबत मा. उच्च न्यायालयास कळविले होते (पृ.4/प.वि.).
(5) याचिकाकर्त्याने रिट याचिका क्र. ____/2026 दाखल केली असून या विभागास प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 करण्यात आले आहे (पृ.5-12/प.वि.).

note.closing: सबब, रिट याचिका क्र. ____/2026 मधील प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 यांचे परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय (इंग्रजी) व सहायक सरकारी वकील यांना पाठवावयाच्या पत्राचे प्रारूप पृ.      /प.वि. वर मान्यतेस्तव सादर. मान्य झाल्यास पत्र निर्गमित करण्यात येईल.

related.heading: Rules for the Conduct of the Legal Affairs of Government, 1984, नियम 58(3), 58(4) व टीप (ii)
text: “(3) … shall prepare or obtain parawise report on all the points raised in the Writ Petition and affidavit.”

“(4) … shall forward the complete case papers, as far as possible. within two weeks from the date of receipt by it …”; “(a) Recommendations whether the Writ Petition should or should not be opposed; (b) self-contained note making references to rules, orders and precedent[s]; (c) such additional information as is likely to help the Government Pleader”

“Note (ii) … the parawise report should not contain cryptic answers such as 'not admitted' or 'denied' but should contain elaborate factual position and should be invariably accompanied by copies of relevant notifications, rules and orders”

letter.subject: रिट याचिका क्र. ____/2026 (श्री. अ. ब. चाचणी विरुद्ध महाराष्ट्र शासन व इतर) मध्ये प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 यांचे परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय पाठविण्याबाबत.
letter.intro: उपरोक्त विषयाबाबत संदर्भाधीन पत्रास अनुसरून आपणांस कळविण्यात येते की, उपरोक्त रिट याचिकेत प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 (विधि व न्याय विभाग) यांचे परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय (इंग्रजी) संबंधित शासन निर्णयांच्या प्रतींसह सोबत पाठविण्यात येत आहेत. सदर अभिप्रायांच्या आधारे प्रतिज्ञापत्राचे प्रारूप तयार करून तथ्यांच्या पडताळणीसाठी या विभागास उपलब्ध करून देण्यात यावे, ही विनंती.
letter.enclosure: सोबत :- परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय (इंग्रजी) व संबंधित शासन निर्णयांच्या प्रती.

paras.averment: Description of the petitioner and the Article under which the petition is filed.
paras.remarks: Needs no remarks as the contents of this para relate to the description of the petitioner and the provision under which the petition is filed. It is, however, denied that the petitioner is entitled to the reliefs claimed.
Needs no remarks as the contents of these paras are a matter of record and relate to the description of the Respondents.

paras.averment: The petitioner's appointment as ____ on __.__.____ and his service particulars.
paras.remarks: As per the service record of the District and Sessions Court, ____ received from the High Court with its letter dated __.__.2025, the petitioner was appointed as ____ by order dated __.__.____ and joined on __.__.____. The averments beyond that record are not within the knowledge of this Respondent and the petitioner may be put to strict proof thereof.

paras.averment: The petitioner claims that he completed the qualifying service of ____ years on __.__.____.
paras.remarks:
The contents of these sub-paras are denied in so far as it is claimed that the petitioner completed the qualifying service on __.__.____.
Government Resolution No. ____ dated __.__.____, paragraph ____, prescribes ____ years of regular service and the condition of ____ for the grant of the ____ benefit. As per the service record, the petitioner's regular service is counted from __.__.____; the period from __.__.____ to __.__.____ was on an ad hoc basis and is not counted as regular service under paragraph ____ of the said Government Resolution.

paras.averment: The representation dated __.__.2025 was not considered.
paras.remarks: The contents of this para are denied. The representation dated __.__.2025 was received through the High Court and was considered. The Department communicated its decision to the High Court under letter No. ____ dated __.__.2025, stating the reason with reference to paragraph ____ of Government Resolution No. ____ dated __.__.____.

paras.averment: The rejection is arbitrary and violates Articles 14 and 16 of the Constitution of India.
paras.remarks: The contents of this ground are denied. The decision was taken by applying the uniform conditions laid down in Government Resolution No. ____ dated __.__.____, which apply equally to all employees of the cadre. The said Government Resolution has not been challenged in the petition.

paras.averment: Similarly placed employees were granted the benefit.
paras.remarks: The contents of this ground are denied. The petitioner has not named the employees said to be similarly placed. The benefit is granted only to employees who fulfil the conditions of Government Resolution No. ____ dated __.__.____.

paras.averment: No delay in filing the petition.
paras.remarks: The contents of this para are not admitted. The decision on the representation was communicated under letter dated __.__.2025, and the petitioner may be put to strict proof of the explanation for the period thereafter.

paras.averment: Formal paras: no other petition filed, jurisdiction, court fee.
paras.remarks: Needs no remarks as the contents of these paras are formal in nature and a matter of record.
